questions.stem: Which sampling method gives every member of the population an equal chance of selection?

feedback.general: Simple random sampling gives every member an equal and independent chance.

metadata.Rationale: Convenience, quota and snowball sampling all depend on who is easy to reach.

questions.stem: A larger sample always removes bias from a study.

metadata.Explanation: Size reduces random error, not bias from how the sample was chosen.

questions.stem: Explain why a sampling frame matters.

feedback.general: A good answer says the frame decides who can be selected at all.
